card.name: Domain ending inside web addresses
card.fires_on: The domain ending (.gov or .com) right after a site name like www.fda or www.newsweek inside a web address. Mostly in FDA companion-diagnostics links.

modes.label: FDA link ending
modes.description: The .gov after https://www.fda in companion diagnostics test statements.

modes.label: Other web addresses
modes.description: A domain ending or dot inside other links or site names.

card.writes: Little clear effect; it may favor characters that continue a web address or end a line.
card.plain: It marks the end of a website name in a link, especially FDA links about approved tests.
